description: Fixed-coil pressure response of the magnetic axis: VMEX free boundary vs first-order theory

configuration.pressure: p = p0 (1 - s), zero current, PHIEDGE = pi B0 a_b^2, B0 = 1 T

solver.settings: NS 17/33/65 cold to FTOL 1e-10, then restart on NS 65 to 1e-14 and 1e-15 (1e-16 for the warm checks); MPOL 8, NTOR 8, NZETA 32, DELT 0.5; direct Biot-Savart coils

theory.note: xi = p0 * X with p0 = -p2 a^2 the axis pressure; X per Pa; traced is the primary theory

linear_fit_vacuum_subtracted.model: ratio*beta = k1*beta + k2*beta^2 over the ladder
